versions.changelog: v1.0.8 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

Security review fixes (5 findings). Approval gates: a Step 0 dry-run now lists what is missing, what will be created, what will not be touched and what needs separate approval, and waits for confirmation before any write. AGENTS.md, WORKSPACE.md, SOUL.md and USER.md are treated as user-owned assets - rule persistence into AGENTS.md is propose-only by default, with the exact diff shown and the effect on future sessions stated, written only after explicit approval. Scope limits: the former path-conflict arbitration is now a file-placement convention limited to where this workspace's own output goes; a skill's safety rules, licence and workflow stay authoritative, output paths are mapped rather than overridden, skills that must write outside the workspace are honoured, and unresolvable conflicts return to the user. Activation narrowed to an explicit initialise/repair request in a confirmed workspace root, with exclusions for existing project structures, competing conventions, passive questions and already-compliant workspaces. Docs aligned across README (zh/en) and both templates; repo-side notes are excluded from the published bundle.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- Minor documentation update in SKILL.md, including mention of the sister project xiaoyaoclaw-memory-distill and expanded system directory notes.
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill logic.

- Renamed the skill from "openclaw-workspace-initializer" to "xiaoyaoclaw-workspace-initializer".
- Updated documentation links and log messages to reflect the new skill name and repository.

- No changes to core initialization logic or workflow.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md from the repository.
- No functional or behavior changes; only a documentation/sample asset was deleted.

- Added section on handling output path conflicts between skills and workspace directory rules, with arbitration principles for path management.
- Clarified that WORKSPACE.md is the single authoritative source for path specifications and output locations.
- Stated that agents must translate skill-specified paths to fit workspace conventions and report any differences to the user.
- Removed the skill-card.md file; no changes to core workflow or functionality.

- Added templates/AGENTS-config-safety.md to provide configuration safety guidelines.
- Added templates/WORKSPACE.md as a standard workspace directory rules template.
- Removed deprecated or redundant skill-card.md.
- No functional changes; this update standardizes documentation and templates for easier workspace setup and safer multi-agent configuration.

Initial release of openclaw-workspace-initializer.

- Provides OpenClaw workspace initialization and standardization for agents.
- Sets up standard directory structure (projects, tasks, outputs, knowledge, scripts, memory, tmp).
- Ensures presence of WORKSPACE.md directory management rules and multi-agent config safety.
- Guides new agents to follow workspace conventions and configuration safety rules.
- Supports initialization logging and AGENTS.md updates if present.

- Removed 10 files, including documentation (.gitignore, LICENSE, README.md), assets (quickstart step images), and templates (AGENTS-config-safety.md, WORKSPACE.md).
- All quickstart image assets and related documentation are now referenced via an external GitHub repository instead of being included in the skill.
- Updated SKILL.md to point users and agents to the official GitHub repository for complete documentation and guides.
- Core functionality and workflow remain unchanged; only bundled resource files and in-repo docs were removed.

openclaw-workspace-initializer v0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Detects and creates missing standard workspace directories and WORKSPACE.md.
- Provides multi-agent config safety: requires config.patch, forbids config.apply.
- Writes workspace rules and config conventions into AGENTS.md when present.
- Logs initialization in memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md for audit and traceability.
